page.layout: One printed page with one column of running text, no margin notes. Running head at top centre. Page number at top right. Catchword and gathering signature at the foot.

main_text.p: rum asidua exercitatione in structus,& iā senex Partitiones oratorias edidit. Huius aũt artificiosæ tractationis quęuis ac facultas sit, nō ante commodè perspiciemus, quàm quot, quęq; sint eius partes, cognouerimus. Sunt aũt sex, de quib. singulis Cicero in Partitionib. ita scribit: In omnib. inquit, causis tres « sunt gradus: ex quib. unus aliquis capiendus est, si plures « non queas, ad resistendū. Nā « aut ita consistendum est, ut « quod obijcitur, factū neges: « aut illud quod factū fateare, « neges eam uim habere, atq; « id esse quod aduersarius cri- «
main_text.notes: The running head and page number are printed. "mi-" is the catchword, "g" the signature. The small mark at the right edge of the text area is a stray mark, not text. Long s is transcribed as s throughout. The "«" marks at line ends are printed quotation marks and are kept. "aliquis" is written whole because the printed line break has no hyphen. The text at "cri-" continues onto the next page. The scan shows a few damaged letters on the left edge, but all printed words are legible.
